negative_snippets: Very dirty and unsafe area. Nobody at the reception, nobody even notices your arrival unless you ask around. Then you realise the guy in charge leisurely walk up the stairs from the offensive smelling gym and needs to be told you have a reservation. Rooms are small, dirty and not maintained well and toilet is the dirtier than a cowshed with scant water supply. They provide “Bisleri” water bottles but the water would actually smell like catpiss, because they fill old water bottles and sell them at the price of a new one. Oh, when it rains, good luck with all the mosquitoes and the drain water overflowing to form a mini-lake of sorts in front of the OYO room building. Pathetic experience. I’d never suggest this to even people I hate. This is pure hell.
